title: Cellular Lipid Extraction for Targeted Stable Isotope Dilution Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry Analysis
protocol: Aliquot the equivalent volume of 1 μg of each standard into a 10 mL volumetric flask using a calibrated syringe.
Dry the standards under nitrogen.
Reconstitute the dried standards in 10 mL of acetonitrile.
Divide the reconstituted solution into 1 mL aliquots and store at -80°C.
Aliquot the equivalent volume of 1 μg of each internal standard (IS) into a 10 mL volumetric flask using a calibrated syringe.
Dry the internal standards under nitrogen.
Reconstitute the dried internal standards in 10 mL of acetonitrile.
Divide the reconstituted solution into 1 mL aliquots.
Collect 3 mL of media from each 10 cm plate of adherent cells (~1 X 10^7 cells).
Wash the cells twice with phosphate buffered saline (PBS).
Add 1 mL of PBS to the cell culture plate and scrape off the cells, transferring them into a second 10 mL glass centrifuge tube.
Store samples at -80°C for long-term storage or at -20°C for less than one week if not continuing immediately.
Add 10 μL of ISM to the collected media.
Label eight additional 10 mL glass centrifuge tubes #0-7 for calibration standards and add 3 mL of PBS to each tube.
Add 10 μL of the appropriate SM to tubes 1-7, corresponding to calibration standard concentrations.
Allow ISM to equilibrate in each sample and calibration standard for 10 minutes.
Add 5 mL of diethyl ether to each sample and standard.
Shake samples and standards at low speed on a shaker for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge all calibration standards and samples at 1935 x g for 10 minutes.
Transfer the upper phase (organic layer) into new 10 mL glass centrifuge tubes using a Pasteur pipet.
Dry the organic phase under nitrogen.
Spin down cell samples in glass centrifuge tubes at 1935 X g for 5 minutes.
Dispose of the supernatant from the cell samples.
Add 2 mL of PBS to each tube containing the cell lysate.
Vortex briefly after adding PBS to each tube.
Remove 25 μL of sample for protein quantification.
Transfer half of the lysate/PBS mixture into a separate 10 mL glass centrifuge tube.
Add an additional 2 mL of PBS and 10 μL of ISM to each sample.
Add 5 mL of CHCl3/MeOH (2:1) to each of the samples.
Shake the samples on low speed for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the samples at 1935 x g for 10 minutes after shaking.
Transfer the bottom (organic) layer of the l-l extraction into a new 10 mL glass centrifuge tube using a Pasteur pipet.
Dry the sample under nitrogen.
Esterified lipids must be saponified before quantification.
Add 0.5 mL of 0.4N KOH in 80% MeOH to each tube.
Incubate the samples at 60°C for 1 hour.
After incubation, add 2 mL of PBS to each sample.
Adjust the pH to 6 with concentrated HCl (~30 μL).
Add 10 μL of ISM to each sample.
Vortex the samples thoroughly.
Incubate the samples at 60°C for 1 hour.
Dry the samples under nitrogen.
Store the dried samples at -80°C if not analyzed immediately or at -20°C for up to one week.
Reconstitute dried down samples and calibration standards in 100 μL of hexane/ethanol (97:3).
Transfer the entire reconstituted sample to an HPLC vial with insert.
Place the samples in a chilled autosampler at 4°C.
Create a sample list for analysis.
Set up the HPLC and MS methods using parameters described.
Use a Chiralpak AD-H column (4.6 X 250 mm, 5 μ) heated to 30°C.
Start with mobile phase consisting of 98% hexane and 2% methanol/isopropanol (1:1).
Add methanol post-column at 0.75 mL/min to avoid deposition on the Corona needle.
Set MS in negative ion mode using APCI source.
Insert a Corona needle if changing from ESI to APCI source.
Run a hexane blank as the first sample to equilibrate the column and check for contamination.
Run calibration standard samples in order from 0 to 7, increasing SM concentration.
Create a calibration curve with the ratio of standard area/IS area on the y-axis and standard concentration or mass on the x-axis.
Use the equation y = mx + b derived from the plot to determine sample (unknown) amount or concentration.
Normalize the amount of bioactive lipids in media to the total volume of media.
Normalize the amount of lipids found in cell lysate to either total number of cells per plate or total protein per plate.
Set up the mass spectrometer according to the provided parameters for each compound:
- For **15-oxoETE**: Collision Energy (CE) = 18 V, Retention Time (RT) = 8.1 min.
- For **13(R)-HODE** and **13(S)-HODE**: CE = 18 V, RT for 13(R)-HODE = 12.5 min, RT for 13(S)-HODE = 14.8 min.
- For **9(R)-HODE** and **9(S)-HODE**: CE = 18 V, RT for 9(R)-HODE = 13.7 min, RT for 9(S)-HODE = 21.2 min.
- For **[2H4]-9(S)-HODE**: CE = 18 V, RT = 21.2 min.
- For **20-HETE** and **[2H6]-20-HETE**: CE = 18 V, RT for 20-HETE = 12.4 min, RT for [2H6]-20-HETE = 12.4 min.
- For **5(R)-HETE** and **5(S)-HETE**: CE = 16 V, RT for 5(R)-HETE = 15.7 min, RT for 5(S)-HETE = 16.2 min.
- For **[2H8]-5(S)-HETE**: CE = 16 V, RT = 16.4 min.
- For **12(R)-HETE**, **12(S)-HETE**, and **[2H8]-12(S)-HETE**: CE = 14 V, RT for 12(R)-HETE = 11.71 min, RT for 12(S)-HETE = 12.3 min, RT for [2H8]-12(S)-HETE = 12.5 min.
- For **15(R)-HETE**, **15(S)-HETE**, and **[2H8]-15(S)-HETE**: CE = 13 V, RT for 15(R)-HETE = 12.4 min, RT for 15(S)-HETE = 15.9 min, RT for [2H8]-15(S)-HETE = 16.1 min.
- For **11(R)-HETE** and **11(S)-HETE**: CE = 16 V, RT for 11(R)-HETE = 11.1 min, RT for 11(S)-HETE = 12.5 min.
- For **8(R)-HETE** and **8(S)-HETE**: CE = 16 V, RT for 8(R)-HETE = 11.7 min, RT for 8(S)-HETE = 12.6 min.
- For **LTB4** and **[2H4]-LTB4**: CE = 18 V, RT = 32.0 min (for both).
- For **PGE2** and **[2H4]-PGE2**: CE = 18 V, RT = 31.2 min (for both).
- For **PGD2** and **[2H4]-PGD2**: CE = 25 V, RT = 32.5 min (for both).
- For **8-iso-PGE2**: CE = 18 V, RT = 37.4 min.
- For **11β-PGF2** and **[2H4]-11β-PGF2**: CE = 25 V, RT = 27.6 min (for both).
- For **PGF2α** and **[2H4]-PGF2α**: CE = 25 V, RT = 33.1 min (for both).
Ensure that the instrument is calibrated properly before starting the analysis to achieve accurate results for each compound listed above.
